name: White Oiled Chevron Parquet
description: White-oiled oak chevron with a pale Nordic finish. Interlocking parquet blocks with micro-bevelled joints and alternating grain direction.

projection.tiling_note: Herringbone and chevron read correctly only with planar UVs; keep the pattern axis parallel to walls.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 1 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 1 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Heirloom parquet wears along walkways; add dust in micro-bevels.

snippets.blender_bpy:
# hypbr atlas: White Oiled Chevron Parquet (white_oiled_chevron_parquet) | 1 tile = 1 m x 1 m | Blender 3.4+
import bpy, os, tempfile, urllib.request
MAT_ID, BASE = 'white_oiled_chevron_parquet', 'https://hypbr.vercel.app/assets/mats/white_oiled_chevron_parquet/'
SURFACE_W, SURFACE_H = 5, 4  # meters covered by UV 0..1 (UV mode)
cache = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), 'hypbr', MAT_ID); os.makedirs(cache, exist_ok=True)
def img(name, data):
    p = os.path.join(cache, name)
    if not os.path.exists(p): urllib.request.urlretrieve(BASE + name, p)
    im = bpy.data.images.load(p, check_existing=True)
    im.colorspace_settings.name = 'Non-Color' if data else 'sRGB'
    return im
mat = bpy.data.materials.new('hypbr_' + MAT_ID); mat.use_nodes = True
N, L = mat.node_tree.nodes, mat.node_tree.links
bsdf, out = N['Principled BSDF'], N['Material Output']
tc, mp = N.new('ShaderNodeTexCoord'), N.new('ShaderNodeMapping')
mp.inputs['Scale'].default_value = (SURFACE_W / 1, SURFACE_H / 1, 1.0)
L.new(tc.outputs["UV"], mp.inputs['Vector'])
def tex(name, data):
    t = N.new('ShaderNodeTexImage'); t.image = img(name, data)
    L.new(mp.outputs['Vector'], t.inputs['Vector']); return t
L.new(tex('albedo_delit.webp', False).outputs['Color'], bsdf.inputs['Base Color'])
orm = N.new('ShaderNodeSeparateColor'); L.new(tex('orm.webp', True).outputs['Color'], orm.inputs['Color'])
L.new(orm.outputs['Green'], bsdf.inputs['Roughness']); L.new(orm.outputs['Blue'], bsdf.inputs['Metallic'])
nm = N.new('ShaderNodeNormalMap'); L.new(tex('normal.webp', True).outputs['Color'], nm.inputs['Color'])  # OpenGL +Y
L.new(nm.outputs['Normal'], bsdf.inputs['Normal'])
aux = N.new('ShaderNodeSeparateColor'); L.new(tex('aux.webp', True).outputs['Color'], aux.inputs['Color'])
dsp = N.new('ShaderNodeDisplacement'); dsp.inputs['Scale'].default_value = 0.003; dsp.inputs['Midlevel'].default_value = 0.5
L.new(aux.outputs['Red'], dsp.inputs['Height']); L.new(dsp.outputs['Displacement'], out.inputs['Displacement'])
bsdf.inputs['IOR'].default_value = 1.53
obj = bpy.context.active_object
if obj is not None and obj.type == 'MESH': obj.data.materials.append(mat)
